title: THE CHIP THAT CHANGED EVERYTHING
subtitle: Why one company became the bottleneck for modern computing

beats.text: Almost every advanced chip on Earth passes through one extraordinary bottleneck.
It is not a consumer brand. Most people have never heard of it.
But its technology sits inside the supply chain of the world's most powerful computers.
That is what makes the semiconductor story so unusual: power is concentrated in places the public rarely sees.
